\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{spy}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[spy using outlines={rectangle,magnification=4,width=2.2cm,height=1.1cm,connect spies}]
  \draw[help lines] (-2,-1) grid (2,3);
  \draw[->] (-2.2,0) -- (2.3,0);
  \draw[->] (0,-1.2) -- (0,3.2);
  \draw[thick,blue] (-2,2) -- (-1,0.5) -- (0,0) -- (1,0.5) -- (2,2);
  \draw[thick,red] (-2,1.2) -- (2,1.2);
  \spy[purple] on (1,0.5) in node[below left] at (-1.2,-1.3);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
